protocol.name: lapin_shell_v1
protocol.description: Small additions the Lapin UX shell needs from the compositor: placing a window in a fraction of the work area (snap layouts) and hearing when a window wants attention (taskbar flashing). Windows are named by the identifier of their ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.

request.name: snap

description.summary: place a window in part of the work area

request.description: Float the window and place it in the given part of the work area of its monitor (panels excluded), in ten-thousandths of the area's width and height. Gaps are applied by the compositor.

event.name: attention
event.description: Sent when a window asks to be activated but isn't given the focus.
